High-resolution (600 dpi) scans of printed Decipher cards from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]], uploaded as WebP (quality 90) with the card corners made transparent. Each File page names the original TIFF and its SHA-256.

Card articles that show one of these files as their High-Res Scan are in [[:Category:Cards with high-res scans]].
